title: Vocabulary Building
seoDescription: Build a bounded token vocabulary from a corpus and encode every sentence as an integer sequence.
description:
Construct a bounded token vocabulary sorted by frequency with <UNK> fallback and map text into integer sequences.

Language vocabulary exhibits heavy-tailed Zipfian frequencies; pruning rare words to <UNK> prevents parameter explosion.

### Mathematical Formulation
$$
V = \{ \text{<UNK>} \} \cup \operatorname{TopK}_{w}(\operatorname{Freq}(w))
$$

### Step-by-Step Implementation
1. Count word occurrences across training corpus
2. Rank tokens by frequency with alphabetical tie-breaking
3. Assign integer IDs to top vocabulary words with UNK fallback mapping

### Returns
Dictionary with 'vocabulary' list and 'encoded_corpus' sequence IDs.
